paragraphs: Ilfi; some say Ilfa, Rosh Hashanah 17b; perhaps those above. Rabbi decreed a fast, but rain did not come. Ilfa went down before him—some say Rabbi Ilfi. He said, “Who makes the wind blow,” and wind blew; “Who brings down rain,” and rain came. Rabbi asked, “What is your practice?” He said there were poor people in the village and he gave them wine for kiddush and havdalah, Ta'anit 24a.
